data.content_ref: inline:reduces to: The isolated artifact's run-record discriminating operation reduces to a special case of SRC_004's unifier — it operationalizes one dimension (operational independence) by inspecting whether the run record contains a falsification operation whose output is world-dependent. The source-independence dimension is bracketed but not negated. Refuted if the artifact's operationalization is shown to require source independence as a precondition to avoid systematic gameability, making the reduction lossy and incomplete.
